card_titles: A dedicated History page on the board: what was done, per day, with every CR merged or dropped, every PR opened, made ready and merged, and every release.
Audit the move of chantier's planning to the planning surface (read-only)
The planning surface (https://github.com/gsemet/gsemet-foss-planning-surface) launches chantier's board and sync with no agent.
audit.py's -u/--set-upstream exemption accepts 'git push -f -u origin main': check forced first (found by CR-191's Inspector, batch-14, pre-existing).
A batch running with the user away is watched by a wake that does not depend on a session being idle.

Planning-folder file types checked by a test (batch-11 retro). CR-184 Inspector caught a plain-text number file in the planning folder, where chantier writes only JSON and Markdown. A structure test or the long gate should catch a non-JSON, non-Markdown file the CLI writes there.

Plugin reload needed as a named block (batch-11 retro). The epoch-1 Foreman ran an old write guard after main removed it and a round was spent for nothing. A CR blocked by a stale loaded plugin should be a named block cause with a take --note path, or the Chief of Staff restarts the Foreman before a batch when a hook of the plugin changed on main.

PR body for an outside reader (batch-11 retro). CR-185 PR body took two Inspector passes on wording: roles and batch terms leaked from the internal references. The Driver card should say the PR body is written for an outside reader from the first draft.

Retro batch-13: nothing of the eval kit was proved on the host (setup.py's allow rules, sandbox.py merge on a real PR, reset --yes with real refs/pull/*). Fix: the first paid campaign proves them, running setup.py from the main checkout since its merge rule embeds the checkout's path.

A spec needing an external fact names its source (batch-11 retro). CR-181 shipped without the claude-fable-5-2 price because no Driver had a network tool to read a price page. The spec-writer card should make a spec that needs an external fact name its source or the tools the Driver needs.

real-direct run 1 retro (2026-11-12, PR 137): plain `status` (and the board) showed a stale spend, $0.57, long after `cost` said $9.57, until `status --refresh`. Fix: `status` and STATUS.json say how old the spend figure is.
Upstream tickets come into the inbox by a setting in `chantier.yaml`, per tracker.
Rewrite the documentation as a Sphinx site on Read the Docs
